purpose: verify the embedding-alignment probe before accepting its verdict

checks.name: kNN train/held-out split audit
checks.finding: Every rank-1 same-string kNN result (def, class, return, const, await, if, true, None, print, request, error, status, route) is a TRAIN-anchor of the Procrustes fit; every failed probe (import, function, async, for, while, false, export, data, schema, model, state) is held-out. The apparent alignment of code tokens is train-set memorization with zero generalization, matching the train-cos 0.484 vs held-out-cos 0.086 gap.

checks.name: probe machinery sanity (Qwen-to-Qwen self-alignment)
checks.protocol: identical Procrustes pipeline, GLM side replaced by Qwen itself; fit on even-index anchors, evaluate on odd-index
checks.verdict: pipeline exact (1.0000); the GLM result is real, not a bug

checks.name: centered variant (mean-removed embeddings)
checks.verdict: the raw probe's +0.009-over-null signal was the shared mean direction; with means removed the cross-space linear structure is zero

conclusion: No generalizable linear alignment exists between GLM-Edge-1.5B and Qwen2.5-Coder-0.5B embedding spaces at 13,773 shared ASCII anchors. This falsifies the necessary condition for ANY closed-form (gradient-free) weight-transfer method at the most favorable site (embeddings, tied to lm_head on both models).
